readme:
# Nano Banana 2 Lite Text to Image

Nano Banana 2 Lite (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image) is the low-latency, lowest-cost Nano Banana tier for high-volume generation at 1K.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 50,000 characters. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `21:9` / `16:9` / `3:2` / `4:3` / `5:4` / `1:1` / `4:5` / `3:4` / `2:3` / `9:16` | — | Output frame shape. |
| `output_format` | `jpeg` / `png` | `png` | Output file format. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |
| `thinking_level` | `minimal` / `high` | — | `high` reasons more about the prompt before drawing; `minimal` is faster. |
| `system_prompt` | string | — | Optional standing instructions applied to every request. |

## Billing

$0.0336 per 1K image, Google's list price.

| Request | Price |
|---|---|
| One image | $0.0336 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Keep prompts direct; use `thinking_level: high` for complex layouts.

## Limits

- Output is 1K only.

## Also on SandBase

Other Nano Banana endpoints: `google/nano-banana-pro`, `google/nano-banana-pro/edit`, `google/nano-banana-2`, `google/nano-banana-2/edit`, `google/nano-banana-2-lite/edit`.
